info.name: PhonePe Clone API v2.0.0
info.description:
A PhonePe-style payments backend with a double-entry ledger and integer-paise money handling.

### Money
Requests take rupees (`amount`, max 2 decimal places — more precision is rejected with 400).
Responses return both `amount` (rupees) and `amountPaise` (exact integer). Nothing is ever stored as a float.

### Authentication
Call `POST /api/auth/login`, then send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Tokens last 30 days and can be
revoked with `POST /api/auth/logout`.

### MPIN
Every outbound payment needs the 4-6 digit MPIN. Set it with `POST /api/auth/setup-mpin`.
Five wrong attempts lock the account for 15 minutes — the counter is per-account, not per-IP.

### Idempotency
Money endpoints accept an `Idempotency-Key` header. Repeating a request with the same key replays the
original response instead of moving money twice.

### Seeded test accounts
After `npm run seed`: `amit@example.com` / `priya@example.com` / `rahul@example.com` / `neha@example.com`,
all with password `password123` and MPIN `1234`.
